title: Companion plugin registry
description: One entry per plugin listed on the /plugins page of companion-lab.github.io. The registry scripts (scripts/validate.mjs and friends) enforce this schema; editors use it for completions via plugins.json's $schema field.

id.description: The plugin's manifest.json id (what the app knows it by). Lowercase letters, digits, and dashes.

repo.description: Full GitHub slug (owner/name) hosting the plugin's source and releases. Any public GitHub repo works, not just companion-lab's.

name.description: Display name shown on the plugin card.

version.description: Latest published release version (the v-prefixed git tag, without the v). Kept fresh automatically by the daily version sync.

description.description: One-to-three sentence card description: what the plugin adds to Companion.

icon.description: FontAwesome solid icon name rendered on the card badge (e.g. fa-comments).

color.description: Theme color key for the card icon. The page's palette knows these four.

permissions.description: The manifest's declared permission list, shown as chips and filterable on the page. New permissions appear as filter chips automatically.

frontend.description: Whether the manifest declares a frontend.entry (bundled React UI).

backend.description: Whether the manifest declares a backend.library (Rust dylib). Backend plugins ship one zip per platform.
